text: The authors describe their task decomposition approach as a specific instantiation of iterated amplification (Christiano et al., 2018), except that they assume a fixed decomposition and start training from the leaf tasks rather than using the entire tree. They state their contribution is showing the approach can be realistically applied to a difficult, large-scale task.
title: Wu et al.'s recursive book summarization is a fixed-decomposition instance of Christiano et al.'s amplification
